prompt: Paint one square flat 2D pixel-art albedo UV texture for the exact existing skinned 3D character in image 1. Image 1 is the UV template: keep all island shapes and positions locked, including the cap and little red star at the bottom center around UV (.387,.886), the diagonal head at the center, the oval eye islands at the right, both gloves-free hands at left, equipment strips, and the tall cloth islands in lower center and lower right. Image 2 is style only, our own game's chunky clean painted pixel clusters; do not copy its UVs or camouflage. Paint a visibly different Yugoslav partisan called Nikoletina. Slate blue/washed navy wool field jacket, collar, upper sleeves and cap, with low-contrast blocky blue-gray folds, simple brown wool trousers with restrained shadows, weathered dark leather boots/belts and satchel, gunmetal buckles, small red star in the cap’s existing badge position, remove the red Soviet shoulder stripes. Paint the diagonal central face texture in the exact same location and orientation, keep both eye sockets, nose, lips and both ears in their exact UV positions, with a broad adult face, angular dark auburn sideburns, clean-shaven cheeks and jaw, chestnut red-brown short hair, thick reddish eyebrows and cool gray-blue eyes. Both circular actual eye texture islands should use a dark slate-blue iris at the same center and scale. Make the skin a fair warm ochre, with 5 shades, matching the hands. Hand-painted pixel art with deliberate small angular pixel clusters and a limited historical palette, deep value separation between wool, leather, and metal, no photo grain, brush noise, gradients, outlines around UV islands, cast shadows or fake three dimensional view. Background gray, output one single square edge-to-edge atlas, no labels, frame or type.
